story.body: In Algeria a chain of intermediaries separates growers from buyers and pushes prices up. We build the direct path: harvested, published, ordered.

story.bullet2: Real stock updated with every order and cancellation

join.title: Sell your produce directly
join.subtitle: One platform for your store, your products and your orders.
join.intro: Set up your store in minutes, add products with your own prices and units, and receive buyer orders directly. The platform handles the storefront, verification, orders and delivery — you handle the land.
join.step1Body: With email or Google. Verify your address with a 6-digit code.
join.step2Body: Store name, description, wilaya and commune, cover image and logo.
join.step3Body: An administrator reviews your details. Once approved, publishing opens and your store goes live.
join.step4Body: Add products with photos, prices and stock, and update them as the season changes.
join.requirement1: A farm or store name and an honest product description
join.requirement2: An accurate location: wilaya and commune
join.requirement3: The pickup or delivery options you actually offer
join.requirement4: Real photos of your products (no images taken from the internet)
join.noticeBody: Verification is a human review. Until it is approved, publishing and orders stay closed. Accounts that break the rules are suspended, with the reason recorded.
join.commissionNote: 0% commission at launch; any change is announced in advance and shown clearly on your sales page.
join.supportNote: Sign-up and verification activate in phase 4, once authentication is built.

about.title: About
about.intro: AgriDirect is straightforward commercial infrastructure: a farmer lists, a buyer orders, and the platform makes sure order, stock, price and delivery work without confusion or deception.
about.missionBody: Give Algerian farmers a fair price and direct access to buyers, and give buyers fresh produce whose origin and real price they know.
about.modelBody: We are neither a farm nor a wholesaler. We are a multi-vendor marketplace: each farmer runs their own store, products, stock and orders, and every store is verified before going live.
about.principle1: No fake products, reviews or figures — every number is computed from the database.
about.principle2: Prices, stock and totals are computed server-side, never in the browser.
about.principle3: Buyer data is shared only with the farmer and courier involved in the order.
about.principle4: Fee transparency: any commission is shown separately and clearly.
about.coverageBody: The model covers 69 wilayas and 1541 communes under the 2026 division, and can be extended as data without rebuilding the system.
about.closingBody: We do not claim absolute security, and we show no online payment before an official gateway is integrated. Our limits and residual risks are documented openly in the repository.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Straight answers on delivery, payment, verification, reviews and cancellation.
faq.item1Answer: Each store defines its delivery zones and fees, or offers farm pickup. Each store's delivery cost is shown before you confirm the order.
faq.item2Answer: No. The first version is cash on delivery only. We will not show online payment before an officially approved gateway is integrated in Algeria.
faq.item3Question: Can I order from several farmers at once?
faq.item3Answer: Yes. One cart is split into a sub-order per store, each handled and delivered independently, with a single clear total paid on delivery.
faq.item4Question: How do I become a verified farmer?
faq.item4Answer: You create your store and submit a verification request. An administrator reviews it and either approves or asks for more information. Nothing is published before approval.
faq.item5Answer: A review is tied to a delivered order line, with one unique identifier per purchase. No review appears without a confirmed delivery.
faq.item6Answer: Before the store confirms, cancellation is immediate. After that, contact the farmer or open a dispute; on cancellation the quantities return to stock.
faq.ctaBody: Send your question from the contact page; the form opens once backend services are complete.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.s1Body: Email, name, phone, address, order and message content, and the usage data required for security. We do not request a national ID number in the first version.
privacy.s2Body: To fulfil orders and delivery, verify farmers, protect the platform from fraud and improve the service. Your data is not used for undisclosed purposes.
privacy.s3Body: The necessary delivery details go only to the farmer involved in the order and the courier. We never sell data or share it for advertising.
privacy.s4Body: Encrypted connections, session tokens stored as hashes, least-privilege permissions and audit logs for sensitive actions. No passwords or verification codes are stored in clear text.
privacy.s5Body: You have the right to access, correct and delete your data under Law 18-07 on the protection of personal data, from your account or the contact page.
privacy.s6Body: Orders are kept for accounting and dispute purposes; unnecessary data is removed when an account is closed, according to the applicable policy.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.s1Body: AgriDirect is a technical marketplace connecting farmers and buyers. The sale is concluded between the farmer and the buyer; the platform organises supply, demand and verifies stores.
terms.s2Body: You are responsible for accurate information and for protecting your sessions. Multiple accounts created to bypass verification or reviews are prohibited.
terms.s3Body: Ownership of the listed products, accuracy of description, price, unit and stock, and fulfilment within the announced time. Forbidden or misleading products are rejected or hidden.
terms.s4Body: All prices are in Algerian dinars and finally computed server-side. Cash on delivery in the first version; no online payment before official activation.
terms.s5Body: Delivery options and fees are set per store and per wilaya. Cancellation depends on order status; disputes open from the order and are handled administratively with a full trail.
terms.s6Body: Fraud, impersonation, unlawful content, attempts to bypass permissions, or disruption of the service. These lead to account suspension with the reason recorded.
terms.s7Body: These terms may change; material changes are announced before they apply. Continuing to use the platform means you accept them.
